description: Données de fréquentation agrégées du réseau STAR au format tableau is a dataset listed in STAR Data Explore open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by STAR. Données de fréquentation du réseau STAR par ligne et par jour Ce jeu de données propose les fréquentations des lignes du réseau STAR par jour l'année civile précédente et l'année civile en cours moins deux mois. Coverage: Rennes Métropole (STAR network). The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are star, lignes, téléchargement, billettique, fréquentation. The portal shows 32,302 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2022-06-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-explore-star-fr-portal.
